searchText: We can’t process a payload before the block. Right now I’m working on adding a reprocess queue for payloads that arrive before blocks so that we can process them once the block arrives but yeah this sounds like a LH bug, thanks for flagging At the moment we are purposely publishing the payload like a second after the block to try and prevent this from happening lol I actually imagined this was why <@412614104222531604> didn't see any split in LH. Thanks for letting me know. I'll continue testing then only with Prysm against these types of reorgs That could explain why Teku may not be working as well, we send payload pretty fast after the block We should do reprocess queue as well we've learned this from our previous interop, I didn't even try against another client before merging this FWIW, I think we're broken today if we get a block for which we haven't seen the payload. We do have the path to request it but it's not merged yet I think.
